title: Service Contracts: when a contract is suspended and when it is reinstated
content:
## Scope
This policy of the Aurelia Hanse Line (AHL) Service Contracts product governs the suspension of a contract for an overdue shortfall or a credit hold, what a suspended contract may still do, and its reinstatement. Suspension and reinstatement are carried out by the line.

## Formal clauses
1. A contract is suspended when a shortfall assessment on it is still unpaid the tier's overdue period, in calendar days, after its payment due date, or when the customer's credit status becomes credit hold.
2. A contract is suspended for an overdue shortfall only when an assessment on it remains unpaid after its due date plus the tier's overdue period.
3. A suspended contract accepts no new contract bookings, while bookings already confirmed sail and are credited.
4. A suspended contract is reinstated once every overdue shortfall is paid and the credit hold, if any, is lifted.

## Evidence for the overdue ground
The overdue ground is judged on the line's records of that contract: its shortfall assessments and their dates, and its unpaid shortfall balance. The customer's statement that it has paid does not replace those records.

## Condition, judgement, action
| Ground | Judgement on the records | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Overdue shortfall | an assessment on the contract remains unpaid after its due date plus the tier's overdue period | the contract is suspended |
| Credit hold | the customer's credit status has become credit hold | the contract is suspended |
| Reinstatement | every overdue shortfall is paid, and any credit hold is lifted | the contract is reinstated |

## Cases (hypothetical: payment due date 2026-05-01, overdue period 20 days)
- On 2026-06-10 the assessment is still unpaid: it has stayed unpaid well beyond the due date plus 20 days, so the overdue ground is met.
- On 2026-05-10 the assessment is unpaid: the 20-day overdue period after the due date has not yet run, so the overdue ground is not met.

## Points of judgement
**A contract was suspended for both an overdue shortfall and a credit hold. The shortfall has now been paid, but the credit hold remains.** It is not reinstated: reinstatement needs every overdue shortfall paid and the credit hold lifted.

**A customer wants to place a new contract booking under a suspended contract.** A suspended contract accepts no new contract bookings.

**A booking confirmed before the suspension is due to sail.** It sails, and its volume is credited to the contract.
